reflections.title: God's Careful Plan for Our Lives

reflect.text: In Ezekiel's vision, an angelic guide carefully measures every part of the temple, from its outer pillars to the Most Holy Place. Every wall, door, and room has an exact size and purpose. Nothing is left to chance.

As F. B. Meyer reminds us, God has an equally careful pattern for our own lives. Just as He planned the dimensions of the sanctuary, God has prepared the shape of our days. Our times of prayer, our sacrifices, our seasons of service, and even our quiet rooms of suffering are already known to Him.

We live with true purpose when we look up to God and seek to follow His will. Meyer encourages us to keep our eyes fixed on Christ, to quiet our own restless thoughts, and to trust God to complete what pleases Him in us.

questions: Are you trying to direct your own path, or are you looking to God's pattern for your life?
How can you practice quieting your own thoughts today so you can rest in God's will?
reflections.prayer: Lord God, thank You for holding a careful plan for every part of my life. Help me to quiet my own restless ways and look up to Christ. Teach me to yield gladly to Your will, trusting that You are shaping me for Your glory. Amen.
